summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz (Nasdaq:KSPI), a foreign private issuer, reporting its 1Q 2026 financial results via press release. It discloses earnings metrics such as e-Commerce GMV growth of 41% YoY, a board-recommended quarterly dividend of KZT 850 per ADS (64% payout ratio), and reiteration of full-year guidance. No special-situation event (merger, tender, activist, restructuring, etc.) is present. The filing is a routine earnings report on Form 6-K, analogous to a US quarterly update, without any extraordinary corporate action.
